linking_rules: Every article must link to /services-guide with contextual anchor text.
Every commercial or transactional article must link to /request-quote with an actionable CTA anchor.
Every article must link to at least 2 sibling articles within its topic cluster.
Cross-cluster links are permitted only when strictly contextually relevant (e.g. Article 01 pricing links to Article 13 sheen comparison).
Anchors must be natural phrases in Arabic, never raw URLs or generic 'click here'.
